Deleting an active process's lock file while it is still running risks a second writer starting up and racing with the first one on brim.bin (spool_path), which is exactly the kind of corruption lock files exist to prevent.
arguments.recommended_action: Before deleting brim_spool.lock, verify on the real system whether pid 4182 / brim_writer is actually alive (procs.snap may itself be stale/simulated data, e.g. from before a crash).
